announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: As a standard post-AGM result announcement for a small-cap explorer, this carries negligible fundamental weight unless it reveals unexpected shareholder rebellion on remuneration or governance proposals.

announcements.headline: Company Update & AGM
announcements.insight: Routine corporate governance filing for a micro-cap explorer with negligible liquidity; AGM updates rarely drive valuation in the absence of material exploration results or financing.

announcements.headline: Annual Results for the year ended 31 December 2025
announcements.insight: As a micro-cap explorer with limited operational history, annual results are critical for validating cash burn rates and funding runway rather than immediate profitability; the market will scrutinize exploration progress against the backdrop of tightening liquidity in junior mining equities.
